chapter.513010FE75551C5A.chapter_subtitl: Grains and a chassis open the smelter; its alloys feed conduits, machines and circuitry. Autocrafting starts at the Precision Mechanism milestone, while the soul line has its own prerequisites.
Read top to bottom · hover a quest to see all its connections
Open a quest to inspect all prerequisites, including links to other chapters. Item tasks check inventory; the description explains assembly and a test run.

quest.51301102C5F5EF51.quest_desc: Iron and an ender pearl produce Pulsating Alloy. Together with Conductive Alloy it supplies the basic item conduit; another share becomes Pulsating Crystals.
quest.51301102C5F5EF51.title: Pulsating Alloy for items
quest.5130110FC0DFEDC3.quest_desc: This extends the corresponding basic conduit. JEI includes direct crafting and upgrade recipes; the previous node identifies the working line being expanded. After replacement, check connections, modes and actual throughput.
quest.5130110FC0DFEDC3.title: Pressurized fluid conduit
quest.513011107F0255F3.quest_desc: This extends the corresponding basic conduit. JEI includes direct crafting and upgrade recipes; the previous node identifies the working line being expanded. After replacement, check connections, modes and actual throughput.
quest.513011107F0255F3.title: Item conduit: Vibrant
quest.51301110F3A4858C.quest_desc: A Soul Vial captures the soul of a supported creature. The item objective checks the empty vial; separately prepare a filled sample of the required type for each Soul Binder recipe.
quest.51301110F3A4858C.title: Soul Vial: the sampling tool
quest.5130111869DF4496.quest_desc: Prepare Conduit Binder Composite using its recipe and send it for smelting. The metal alloy determines conduit capabilities, while the Binder supplies the shared casing material.
quest.5130111869DF4496.title: The conduit binder mixture
quest.5130111D0F34D9B7.quest_desc: Build the Enchanter using this pack's Dark Steel and specialized component recipe. It also becomes an ingredient of the Soul Binder, so prepare another copy if you want to keep an enchanting station on the base.
quest.5130111D0F34D9B7.title: The Enchanter as a production component
quest.5130111D94D99E2B.quest_desc: This pack's Basic Capacitor Bank uses a Basic Capacitor and a Mekanism Basic Energy Cube with precision-stage components. Configure it between generation and Ender IO machines; it belongs to Precision rather than requiring the Matrix.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Basic Capacitor.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Basic Capacitor Bank. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.5130111D94D99E2B.title: Capacitor Bank: a local FE reserve
quest.5130111DBA46A20B.quest_desc: Dark Steel uses iron, obsidian and a carbon source in one of the available recipes. It supplies the Enchanter and leads to End Steel; these branches can run separately from conduits.
quest.5130111DBA46A20B.title: Dark Steel and specialized machines
quest.5130111E28B22B76.quest_desc: This extends the corresponding basic conduit. JEI includes direct crafting and upgrade recipes; the previous node identifies the working line being expanded. After replacement, check connections, modes and actual throughput.
quest.5130111E28B22B76.title: Ender Fluid Conduit
quest.5130112CBAC535EA.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Limited Item Filter (enderio:limited_item_filter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130112CBAC535EA.title: Obtain 1 × Limited Item Filter
quest.51301138C137BDAD.quest_desc: The Soul Binder turns a Vibrant Crystal into an Ender Crystal using an Enderman soul sample, experience and FE. This material leads to specialized obelisks; an empty Soul Vial alone does not satisfy the recipe.
quest.51301138C137BDAD.title: Vibrant Crystal + an Enderman soul
quest.5130113D7D320C50.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Staff of Travelling (enderio:staff_of_travelling). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130113D7D320C50.title: Obtain 1 × Staff of Travelling
quest.513011403518CC36.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Wireless Charger (enderio:wireless_charger). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011403518CC36.title: Obtain 1 × Wireless Charger
quest.51301140FB4C14AE.quest_desc: The Vacuum Chest connects local item collection to the transport network. Configure its working area and storage output so an active farm does not rely on a full chest.
quest.51301140FB4C14AE.title: Vacuum Chest: collection into conduits
quest.51301146B3D81FD6.quest_desc: This extends the corresponding basic conduit. JEI includes direct crafting and upgrade recipes; the previous node identifies the working line being expanded. After replacement, check connections, modes and actual throughput.
quest.51301146B3D81FD6.title: Energy conduit: Vibrant
quest.51301148615D2591.quest_desc: The Soul Binder follows the Slice'n'Splice and Enchanter that supply its actual ingredients. For operation, provide the required Soul Vial, item input, experience and energy. Binding an Ender Crystal is a separate next branch.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Soularium Block.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Soul Binder. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.51301148615D2591.title: Soul Binder: soul, experience and FE
quest.5130114938E63897.quest_desc: Prepare Soularium in the smelting line. Soul Vials, Ensouled Chassis and specialized machinery use it; this branch grows from the Alloy Smelter after basic logistics.
quest.5130114938E63897.title: Soularium: starting the soul branch
quest.5130114A639B43DA.quest_desc: Build the Slice'n'Splice first and make a Z-Logic Controller from Soularium, a zombie head, Silicon and redstone. This processor is required by both Soul Binder and Powered Spawner recipes, so its machine comes first.
quest.5130114A639B43DA.title: Slice'n'Splice before the Soul Binder
quest.5130114AE9005E27.quest_desc: This extends the corresponding basic conduit. JEI includes direct crafting and upgrade recipes; the previous node identifies the working line being expanded. After replacement, check connections, modes and actual throughput.
quest.5130114AE9005E27.title: Energy conduit: Energetic
quest.5130115B49AE7E7C.quest_desc: Redstone Conduits carry control signals through the conduit network. Configure the channel and input/output points to control stations independently of their item filters.
quest.5130115B49AE7E7C.title: Signals control the production line
quest.51301167AE8889AA.quest_desc: This pack's recipe consumes a Soul Binder, Z-Logic Controller, Vibrant Crystal and Broken Spawner alongside other components. After crafting, configure a supported spawner type, power and output collection. Industrial Foregoing later uses this machine in the Mob Duplicator.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Soularium Block.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Powered Spawner. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.51301167AE8889AA.title: Powered Spawner: machine and sample
quest.5130116AAAF4B959.quest_desc: The basic energy conduit uses Conductive Alloy and Binder. Connect source, buffer and machine, then check connection modes. The existing objective recognizes this conduit type rather than any item sharing its base name.
quest.5130116AAAF4B959.title: FE conduit: generator → consumer
quest.513011725F799C0A.quest_desc: The Alloy Smelter combines iron and copper into Conductive Alloy. Basic conduits consume it, and Energetic Alloy uses it as an input, so keep a dedicated stock.
quest.513011725F799C0A.title: Iron + copper → Conductive Alloy
quest.513011734EE3175F.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Basic Fluid Filter (enderio:basic_fluid_filter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011734EE3175F.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Fluid Filter
quest.5130117801127762.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × VAT (enderio:vat). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130117801127762.title: Obtain 1 × VAT
quest.5130118049B3B5BA.quest_desc: This pack's Void Chassis combines Grains of Infinity, iron and an Industrial Chassis. It starts the Alloy Smelter, SAG Mill and part of the automation route; keep spares for separate stations.
quest.5130118049B3B5BA.title: Void Chassis for the first machine
quest.51301183B8CF29F5.quest_desc: Process Energetic Alloy with an ender pearl and glowstone. Vibrant Alloy supplies higher conduits, crystals and the later energy buffer, extending the smelting line you already built.
quest.51301183B8CF29F5.title: Energetic Alloy → Vibrant Alloy
quest.513011841D3B76CA.quest_desc: This pack combines a Basic Capacitor, Energetic Alloy and Precision Mechanism stage components. The capacitor is available before the Dimensional Matrix; the later Advanced Capacitor Bank separately requires the Matrix.
quest.513011841D3B76CA.title: Double-Layer: the next capacitor
quest.51301189AE52B1F5.quest_desc: Power and configure the SAG Mill for your chosen feed. Remove every output, including by-products; available recipes include Cobbled Deepslate with a chance of Grains of Infinity. This expands the component line you already established.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Electromechanical Drive.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture SAG Mill. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.51301189AE52B1F5.title: SAG Mill: grinding and by-products
quest.5130118BFEDE7D48.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Aversion Obelisk (enderio:aversion_obelisk). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118BFEDE7D48.title: Obtain 1 × Aversion Obelisk
quest.5130118E25820DD5.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Pulsating Crystal (enderio:pulsating_crystal). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118E25820DD5.title: Obtain 1 × Pulsating Crystal
quest.5130118E40386623.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Basic Chemical Filter (enderio:basic_chemical_filter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118E40386623.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Chemical Filter
quest.5130118ED672EF1E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Pulsating Photovoltaic Module (enderio:pulsating_photovoltaic_module). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118ED672EF1E.title: Obtain 1 × Pulsating Photovoltaic Module
quest.5130119426F8E5C3.quest_desc: The basic item conduit needs Conductive and Pulsating Alloys. Configure extraction at the source and insertion at the destination; test one recipe before adding filters. This transport feeds the local Crafter in the next section.
quest.5130119426F8E5C3.title: Items between smelter and storage
quest.5130119DF4466A66.quest_desc: Build the Crafter from a Void Chassis, Silicon, BuildCraft Auto Workbench, Control Assembly and Precision Mechanism components. Supply FE and ingredients, configure the recipe and route outputs through Item Conduits. It also feeds the AE2 Crafting Unit recipe and does not require a Dimensional Matrix.
quest.5130119DF4466A66.title: Crafter: repeated crafting before the Matrix
quest.513011AA9C81A28D.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Travel Anchor (enderio:travel_anchor). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011AA9C81A28D.title: Obtain 1 × Travel Anchor
quest.513011AC2178359B.quest_desc: Add gold and redstone to Conductive Alloy in the Alloy Smelter. Energetic Alloy supplies the Double-Layer Capacitor and intermediate conduits; reserve some for Vibrant Alloy.
quest.513011AC2178359B.title: Conductive Alloy → Energetic Alloy
quest.513011AF7BCC8C7E.quest_desc: The Impulse Hopper is a separate station for controlled item input. Configure its batch and signal behavior for the target machine. Its item objective is available at Precision and does not inspect the configuration in the world.
quest.513011AF7BCC8C7E.title: Impulse Hopper for batch input
quest.513011B05E2E9113.quest_desc: This extends the corresponding basic conduit. JEI includes direct crafting and upgrade recipes; the previous node identifies the working line being expanded. After replacement, check connections, modes and actual throughput.
quest.513011B05E2E9113.title: Item conduit: Energetic
quest.513011B5F4763E7A.quest_desc: Grains of Infinity supply early Ender IO components. Use an available source shown in JEI first. A SAG Mill can later obtain them from Cobbled Deepslate, but it needs these starting components itself and is not a prerequisite for the first grains.
quest.513011B5F4763E7A.title: Grains for the first chassis
quest.513011BBFAA4813B.quest_desc: Add end stone and obsidian to Dark Steel in the smelting line. End Steel is the next material in this branch; inspect its consumers in JEI.
quest.513011BBFAA4813B.title: Dark Steel → End Steel
quest.513011BF7BA29A4B.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Vibrant Capacitor Bank (enderio:vibrant_capacitor_bank). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011BF7BA29A4B.title: Obtain 1 × Vibrant Capacitor Bank
quest.513011C540A7B224.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Basic Item Filter (enderio:basic_item_filter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011C540A7B224.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Item Filter
quest.513011C98821DCE8.quest_desc: Copper and redstone in the Alloy Smelter produce Redstone Alloy. Reserve it for signal conduits separately from the alloys used for power.
quest.513011C98821DCE8.title: Redstone Alloy for signals
quest.513011D09E534066.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Energetic Photovoltaic Module (enderio:energetic_photovoltaic_module). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D09E534066.title: Obtain 1 × Energetic Photovoltaic Module
quest.513011D5BDA26046.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Vibrant Photovoltaic Module (enderio:vibrant_photovoltaic_module). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D5BDA26046.title: Obtain 1 × Vibrant Photovoltaic Module
quest.513011D9AD5BA43B.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Silicon (enderio:silicon). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D9AD5BA43B.title: Obtain 1 × Silicon
quest.513011E370A685E5.quest_desc: The basic Fluid Conduit uses Conductive Alloy, Binder and Clear Glass. Check connection modes between tank and consumer; the side filter helps exclude unwanted fluids.
quest.513011E370A685E5.title: Fluids: a separate channel and filter
quest.513011E8D057E271.quest_desc: The Basic Capacitor uses Grains of Infinity, copper and gold nuggets. Prepare capacitors for machines that need them and check the corresponding slot in each interface. Higher capacitors extend this branch later.
quest.513011E8D057E271.title: A capacitor for machine operation
quest.513011F0F034B9F6.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Inhibitor Obelisk (enderio:inhibitor_obelisk). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011F0F034B9F6.title: Obtain 1 × Inhibitor Obelisk
quest.513011F31A34A8F8.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Conduit Probe (enderio:conduit_probe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011F31A34A8F8.title: Obtain 1 × Conduit Probe
quest.513011FD63F841AE.quest_desc: Smelt the Composite into Conduit Binder and keep a stock near conduit crafting. The route now splits into FE, items, fluids and redstone, each with its own alloy requirements.
quest.513011FD63F841AE.title: The smelted network material
quest.513011FDA169E434.quest_desc: The Advanced Item Filter uses a Z-Logic Controller from the Slice'n'Splice. It therefore belongs after specialized component production; the basic filter remains available for the first item line.
quest.513011FDA169E434.title: A smarter filter after Z-Logic
quest.513011FDD244B182.quest_desc: The Advanced Capacitor Bank extends the basic bank through a Double-Layer Capacitor. Both pack recipes also consume a Quantum Processor and Dimensional Matrix, placing this buffer at the third progression stage.
quest.513011FDD244B182.title: More storage for the same network
quest.513011FF94962AA3.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Vibrant Crystal (enderio:vibrant_crystal). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011FF94962AA3.title: Obtain 1 × Vibrant Crystal
quest.514011487657F862.quest_desc: Build the Alloy Smelter from a Void Chassis and iron furnaces using this pack's recipe. Supply FE, install its required capacitor and feed one recipe's ingredients. Its output splits into conduits, energy buffers and soul machinery.
quest.514011487657F862.title: Alloy Smelter: the source of the branches
